crossRefs.note: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have…
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when…
Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.
namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having…

translations.web: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: It is a guilt offering; he was certainly guilty before the LORD.”
translations.kjv: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
translations.asv: It is a trespass-offering: he is certainly guilty before Jehovah.
